comments: 4d786884: This block initializes the Deficiency Tracking View screen.
14d8f729: Call header setup, initialize view variable, and invoke the list display routine.
e3beb76f: Prepare the 'Date Coded' label with an optional asterisk for non-view mode.
b29465cb: Reset the X variable for fresh use.
6a81d4cd: Position and set the 'Date Coded' label within the display string.
323e192c: Convert the internal FileMan date to a regular format for display.
acf4ce83: Update the display string with the 'Date Coded' information and refresh the display.
d11f7f24: End processing for the 'Date Coded' section.
e9c9ea66: Prepare the 'Coded By' label with an optional asterisk for non-view mode.
a59222f8: Reset the X variable for fresh use in the 'Coded By' section.
ba38e5dc: Position and set the 'Coded By' label within the display string.
c77429c2: Retrieve the coder's name from the NEW PERSON file.
d19c99cb: Update the display string with the 'Coded By' information and refresh the display.
9fe9ab95: End processing for the 'Coded By' section.
439d5ef7: Extract visit or admission related date for displaying 'Date Coded' or 'Coded By'.
1e2483c2: End processing for extracting coding information.
ed93939f: This block handles the display of comments associated with a deficiency record.
c938f4b8: Reset the X variable for fresh use in the comments section.
e4acc40c: Insert the comment number into the display string.
a00d86b2: Clear X for new line in comments display.
6f14c5ad: Set the 'Comments:' label at the start of the comment display.
6a38b8ef: Retrieve the comment text from the deficiency record.
0f893da5: Display the first part of the comment (up to 64 characters).
c04c3c28: Reset X for the next line of the comment.
52a90fd1: Display the second part of the comment (characters 65 to 129).
ed157361: Reset X for the next line of the comment.
32d161ab: Display the third part of the comment (characters 130 to 194).
f6159b80: Reset X for the next line of the comment.
356eda23: Display the fourth part of the comment (characters 195 to 232).
7f36f1e8: End of the comments display section.
9c2affe0: This block determines the status of a deficiency record.
01b13327: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if specific fields are empty and it's a service file.
28c41a9c: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if a review date is present but other specific fields are empty.
7ae4891c: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if signed but not reviewed.
478a407c: Set status to 'SIGNED' if the proper sign-off fields are filled.
fa5f6172: Set as 'INCOMPLETE' if the initial date field is empty.
e6d6bb86: Set status to 'DICTATED' if dictation date is present but others are not.
5729faec: Set as 'TRANSCRIBED' if transcription date is present but others are not.
b8a32b27: Set as 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if signed without review.
ed1cd8d5: Set as 'SIGNED' if signed with review date empty.
39656c88: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if reviewed.
d47f47c3: Update the record's status in the database.
0a2867c8: End of the status update routine.
